prompt:
You are shown face-up playing cards arranged as a hand, labeled hands, or labeled candidate cards. Which option letter completes the top hand as three of a kind?
Required annotation format: set "annotation" to an array with the bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the selected candidate card.
Required answer format: set "answer" to only the selected candidate option letter.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[320,300,400,420]],"answer":"B"}
